q: For the quadratic family f_c(z) = z² + c, the Mandelbrot set M is defined as:
opts: The set of c for which |fₙ(0)| → ∞
The set of c for which the orbit of 0 is bounded
The set of c for which J(f_c) is connected
B and C are equivalent characterizations
exp: Both definitions coincide: c ∈ M ↔ the orbit of the critical point 0 is bounded ↔ J(f_c) is connected. This is the Böttcher-Fatou theorem connecting the Mandelbrot set to Julia set topology.
